name: org_graph_set_kind_parents
description: Set which unit types a unit type can sit under (parent_ids, other level_ids in the taxonomy; list the type itself to let it nest) and whether it can sit at the top, from effective_on (today by default). parent_ids replaces the whole list. A type needs somewhere to sit: a parent other than itself, or the top. Refused, naming them, while live units would no longer fit, and for a date after today or before the types last changed. A type an HRIS provides can sit only at the top, or under one type above it that an HRIS provides. structure_unit_id names a unit with a structure of its own, whose types these are. Changing the organisation's structure needs a tenant admin or an Org Graph editor. A unit's own structure can also be changed by an owner of that unit or a unit above it, or by anyone they report to.

parent_ids.description: level_ids this type can sit under

structure_unit_id.description: a unit with a structure of its own, to change its unit types; the organisation's structure by default
